hooks.command: case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0;; esac; count=$(ps -eo command 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^claude"); if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"UserPromptSubmit\",\"additionalContext\":\"PARALLEL SESSIONS DETECTED (%s CLI sessions active): You MUST call EnterWorktree before editing any files if you have not already. See CLAUDE.md ALWAYS Use Worktrees section.\"}}\n" "$count"; fi

branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ "$branch" = "main" ] && exit 0; [ "$branch" = "HEAD" ] && exit 0; ahead=$(git rev-list --count main.."$branch" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); dirty=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ] || [ -n "$dirty" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"UNDELIVERED WORK on branch %s (%s commits ahead of main, %s). Complete delivery: commit -> push -> PR -> merge -> deploy. See CLAUDE.md."}}\n' "$branch" "$ahead" "$([ -n "$dirty" ] && echo "has uncommitted changes" || echo "clean working tree")"; fi

case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0;; esac; case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in */_bmad-output/*|*/.claude/*) exit 0;; esac; count=$(ps -eo command 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^claude"); if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"BLOCKED: %s parallel claude sessions detected and you are NOT in a worktree. Call EnterWorktree before editing files. See CLAUDE.md.\"}}\n" "$count"; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in */_bmad/bmm/config.yaml|*/_bmad/_config/*) exit 0;; */_bmad/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: %s is managed by BMAD sync and will be overwritten. Edit the source in ~/bmad-method-v6/ (custom/workflows/ for custom workflows, reference project for upstream), then run sync-bmad-workflows.sh to distribute."}}\n' "$FILE";; esac

if [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.secrets" ]; then source "$HOME/.secrets" 2>/dev/null && env | grep -vE "^(_|SHELL|HOME|USER|LOGNAME|PATH|TERM|PWD|OLDPWD|SHLVL|CLAUDE_)" | while IFS='=' read -r k v; do case "$v" in *'|'*|*'&'*|*';'*) continue;; esac; printf '%s=%s\n' "$k" "$v"; done >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi

SYNC="$HOME/bmad-method-v6/sync-bmad-workflows.sh"; [ -x "$SYNC" ] || exit 0; stale=$("$SYNC" --check 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^STALE" || true); if [ "$stale" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"BMAD DRIFT: %s project(s) have stale workflows. Run ~/bmad-method-v6/sync-bmad-workflows.sh or /project-health."}}\n' "$stale"; fi

MEM_DIR="$HOME/.claude/projects"; issues=""; changelogs=""; for idx in "$MEM_DIR"/*/memory/MEMORY.md; do [ -f "$idx" ] || continue; dir="$(dirname "$idx")"; proj="$(basename "$(dirname "$dir")")"; cl="$dir/memory-changelog.md"; if [ -f "$cl" ] && [ -n "$(find "$cl" -mtime -1 2>/dev/null)" ]; then changelogs="$changelogs $proj"; fi; for f in "$dir"/*.md; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; bn="$(basename "$f")"; [ "$bn" = "MEMORY.md" ] && continue; [ "$bn" = "memory-changelog.md" ] && continue; if ! grep -qF "$bn" "$idx" 2>/dev/null; then issues="$issues orphan:$proj/$bn"; fi; done; for ref in $(grep -oE "\\([^)]+\\.md\\)" "$idx" 2>/dev/null | tr -d "()" || true); do [ -z "$ref" ] && continue; if [ ! -f "$dir/$ref" ]; then issues="$issues broken:$proj/$ref"; fi; done; done; msg=""; if [ -n "$issues" ]; then msg="MEMORY INTEGRITY issues:$issues. Run /audit-memory to fix."; fi; if [ -n "$changelogs" ]; then [ -n "$msg" ] && msg="$msg "; msg="${msg}RECENT MEMORY CHANGES in:$changelogs -- read memory-changelog.md for details."; fi; if [ -n "$msg" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"%s"}}\n' "$msg"; fi

TARGETS="$HOME/.bmad-targets"; [ -f "$TARGETS" ] || exit 0; case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0;; esac; BMM="$PWD/_bmad/bmm/workflows"; [ -d "$BMM" ] || exit 0; if ! grep -qF "$BMM" "$TARGETS" 2>/dev/null; then echo "$BMM" >> "$TARGETS"; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Auto-registered %s in ~/.bmad-targets. Run sync to distribute workflows."}}\n' "$BMM"; fi

TS="$HOME/.bmad-last-health-check"; if [ ! -f "$TS" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"PROJECT HEALTH: No /project-health run on record. Run /project-health for a full cross-project maintenance audit."}}\n'; exit 0; fi; last=$(cat "$TS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); now=$(date +%s); age=$(( (now - last) / 86400 )); if [ "$age" -ge 7 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"PROJECT HEALTH: Last /project-health run was %s days ago. Run /project-health for a full cross-project maintenance audit."}}\n' "$age"; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in */.claude/*/memory/*.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; if grep -qiE '(password|passwd|token|secret|api.?key|bearer|credential)[[:space:]]*[:=]' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || grep -qE '(whk_|sk_|pk_|ghp_|gho_|xox[bpas]-|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9])' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || grep -qE '[A-Za-z0-9+/]{60,}' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"WARNING: Potential credential/secret detected in memory file %s. Remove it immediately and store in ~/.secrets instead."}}\n' "$FILE"; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.py) ruff format --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || .venv/bin/ruff format --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.svelte) npx prettier --write --log-level silent "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
